//: Example Aibou policy. Copy to ~/.aibou/policy.json to use it.
Aibou ships sensible defaults, so this file is entirely optional -- with no
policy.json present the built-in rules apply. Run the Bridge to see which
policy is active; it prints e.g. 'Policy: built-in defaults (6 rules)'.
Save as UTF-8. A UTF-8 BOM is tolerated, but anything unparseable makes the
Bridge fall back to paranoid mode (escalate everything) rather than fail open.
Evaluation order, regardless of how rules are ordered here:
1. any matching 'deny'     wins
2. else any 'escalate'     wins
3. else any 'allow'        wins
4. nothing matched         -> escalate (fail closed)
Conditions inside one 'when' are ANDed. Available conditions:
tool            string or array; matches the agent's tool name
(_meta.kiro.toolName, e.g. 'shell') or the ACP tool kind
(e.g. 'execute', 'read', 'edit'). Supports * and prefix_*.
pathIn          'cwd' | 'outside_cwd' -- relative to the session directory
pathMatches     glob against the target path, e.g. '*.env'
pathRegex       regex against the target path (unanchored, case-insensitive)
commandMatches  regex against the command string (unanchored, case-insensitive)
A rule with an empty 'when' is ignored, so a malformed rule cannot
accidentally allow or deny everything.

rules.reason: The agent must not rewrite Aibou's own configuration.
Rewriting or force-pushing history is never allowed unattended.
Touches a credential or secret file.
Running the test suite is routine; approve without interrupting.
